text:
alex: FYI planning a small kernel + quant-profile push tonight during the 01:00 UTC quiet window. Owners: alex (kernel), maria (quant). Expect ~30m. Need smoke owner(s) + rollback assist. Can anyone pick up smoke and watch the metrics? :pray:

chris: I can own smoke for EU region. What exactly should I run and where are the scripts?

alex: Nice—thx. Smoke steps (short):
1) deploy to canary slice
2) warm KV cache
3) run perf sanity script (p95/p99 checks)
4) validate traces/error rates + simple LLM prompts
Commands below:
```
# warm KV cache
curl -X POST https://canary-api.redwood/internal/warmup -d '{"model":"gpt-4r","prefixes":["hello","summarize"]}'
# perf sanity
./tools/perf_check --target canary --seq 512 --qps 50
```

maria: Rollback criteria I've set: p95 latency > 350ms OR error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m -> rollback. I'm pushing quant artifact quant/v1.4.3 and kernel patch k-2026-0317. Snapshots and rollout keys are prepped.

tanvi: I'll monitor dashboards (01:00-02:00 UTC). I'll watch tokens/sec, p95, error rate, and model-failure traces. If anything looks off I'll ping #incidents and @oncall.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window at 01:00 UTC, canary slice slice-17, rollout_id r-2026-03-17-01

joel: I'm not on pager this window but can stand by for rollback steps if someone needs a hand.

alex: Quick preflight checks before we go live:
- maria: unit tests green? artifact path? 
- chris: do you have perf script access? 
- tanvi: will you update incident channel if we flip rollback?

maria: CI green, unit/integ tests passed. Artifact location: s3://redwood-artifacts/quant/v1.4.3.tar.gz

chris: perf script path is OK, permissions in place.

tanvi: I'll post the runbook link in 15m: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/engine-deploy

alex: Great. Plan is to start roll at 01:00 UTC, canary for 5m, then gradual ramp if all good. If anyone wants to rehearse rollback steps before, ping me now. :thumbsup:
